scope: YouTube videos keep playing past the first minute.

topics.title: YouTube in your own Chrome
details: YouTube sometimes stops a video after about a minute in Voice Companion's Chrome. It says something went wrong.
Now the video goes on in your own Chrome, from where it stopped. This needs the Voice Companion extension in Chrome.
After that, YouTube opens in your own Chrome. Your keys work the same.

topics.title: YouTube messages
details: YouTube's error no longer ends with the words Learn more.
